body.statement: Can the exact pilot-localized multinomial inversion handle be completed so that \(\inf_{P\in\mathcal P_L}P\{(\underline\theta_d(p),\overline\theta_d(p))_{d\in\mathcal D}\in\mathcal I_{N,1-\alpha}\}\ge1-\alpha\) for every \(N\), including empty arms, zero cells, and tied active facets, while at each fixed positive-support law with one separated active contrast and positive contrast variance the corresponding scalar side of \(\mathcal I_{N,1-\alpha}\) is asymptotically equivalent to the semiparametrically efficient Wald interval?
body.justification: Identification without boundary-valid uncertainty quantification is inadequate for sparse multi-arm ordinal trials.
body.gap: ChoRussell2024 perturbs LPs for uniform validity and FangSantos2019 simulates directional derivatives; neither delivers finite-sample support honesty plus pointwise efficient scalar adaptation for this six-endpoint map.
body.consumer: The result supplies a single prespecified report that remains honest in small trial cells without paying a permanent efficiency penalty on regular faces.
